items.title_en: Real Or Fake? Avengers Doomsday: Doctor Doom Warns Thor, Steve Rogers 'No Miracle Coming' In 'Leaked' Clip - F
items.summary_en: An alleged leaked video from Avengers Doomsday showing Doctor Doom facing Thor, Steve Rogers and other Marvel superheroes has gone viral on social media. The clip features several familiar Marvel characters, including Chris Hemsworth, Chris Evans, Shang-Chi, Sam Wilson, Cyclops, and X-Men members. In the video, Doctor Doom warns the superheroes that no miracle will save them. While the clip has caught the attention of Marvel fans, many have questioned whether it is real, Hollywood, Times Now
items.title_zh: 真还是假？复仇者联盟末日：毁灭博士在“泄露”片段中警告托尔、史蒂夫·罗杰斯“不会出现奇迹” - F
items.summary_zh: 一段据称被泄露的《复仇者联盟末日》视频显示，毁灭博士面对雷神、史蒂夫·罗杰斯和其他漫威超级英雄，该视频在社交媒体上疯传。该片段出现了几个熟悉的漫威角色，包括克里斯·海姆斯沃斯、克里斯·埃文斯、上气、山姆·威尔逊、镭射眼和 X 战警成员。在视频中，毁灭博士警告超级英雄们，没有奇迹可以拯救他们。虽然这段视频引起了漫威粉丝的注意，但许多人质疑它是否真实，霍尔
